definition: Coach recorded as the team head coach for observed regular-season games.
assignment_rule: Game-level nflverse head-coach fields; intervals use first and last observed regular-season game weeks.

definition: Coach formally titled offensive coordinator or co-offensive coordinator.
assignment_rule: Official preseason NFL staff listing; in-season changes require separate dated evidence.

definition: Coach with explicit responsibility for communicating the primary offensive play calls during games.
assignment_rule: Requires dated explicit evidence and interval; never inferred from HC or OC title.
not_equivalent_to: Head coach or offensive coordinator title alone

definition: Primary coach formally assigned to the quarterbacks position group.
assignment_rule: Official staff listing; assistant QB coaches are not promoted to this role.
not_equivalent_to: Passing-game coordinator or assistant quarterbacks coach
